Title: Enacts "Jacob Freytes' law"
Summary: Enacts "Jacob Freytes' law; provides that a person is guilty of murder in the second degree when they recklessly cause the death of a person less than eighteen years old; relates to sentences of imprisonment for felonies for causing the death of a person less than eighteen years old.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the penal law, in relation to enacting "Jacob Freytes' law"
